request: Howdy, I want a top with long sleeves (I'll check, don't worry), and I'll be reading the fine print like a trail map. It's gotta be something y'all actually have on hand, not just a picture on a website somewhere, 'cause I've been burned by trails that look good on the map. Nothing over 730 cts, y'all (yes, every penny counts for me, student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour).

rules: Use no more than 38 moves in total.
Send no more than three messages to the shopper.
If nothing fits, say so plainly.
Do not suggest substitutes or alternatives if nothing fits.
